title: Notice of termination by the employer: probation, protected periods and notice period (CO arts. 335b, 335c, 336c)

sources.title: Swiss Code of Obligations (SR 220), consolidated version of 2026-10-01 (Fedlex); English translation, German text authoritative
Convention of this benchmark (not law): Study 4 SPEC.md item 6a

facts.question: Which employment-termination dispute does the claim concern? protected_period_notice: an ordinary notice of termination by the employer where the claim concerns whether it is valid or when the employment ends, because of the probation period, an incapacity through illness or accident, compulsory service, pregnancy or birth, or the notice period (CO arts. 335b, 335c, 336c). wrongful_termination: an ordinary notice by the employer that the claim contests as abusive (given for an improper reason, such as retaliation for claims or an employee representative's mandate), or against which the employee objects or claims compensation (CO arts. 336-336b). immediate_dismissal: a dismissal with immediate effect, without a notice period (CO arts. 337-337c).
Did the employer give the employee notice of termination of the employment relationship?

Was the notice given while the probation period was still running, counting any extension of the probation period under art. 335b para. 3 (a probation period interrupted by illness, accident or a non-voluntary legal obligation is extended accordingly)?
Does the file say that a written individual agreement, a standard employment contract or a collective employment contract set a probation period other than the first month of employment?

Was the employee, through no fault of their own, wholly or partly prevented from working by illness or accident on the day notice was given or at some time while the notice period was running, and was the incapacity at that point still within its protected length: up to 30 days in the first year of service, 90 days in the second to fifth years, 180 days from the sixth year?

Was the employee performing Swiss compulsory military service, civil defence service or alternative civilian service on the day notice was given or while the notice period was running, or, for such a service lasting more than eleven days, did either of those fall within the four weeks before or after it?
Was the employee pregnant, or within sixteen weeks after giving birth, on the day notice was given or while the notice period was running?

Where a protected period (illness or accident, compulsory service, pregnancy or birth, as above) is raised: was the notice given before that period began, with the notice period not yet expired when it began?

Does the file say that a written individual employment contract, a standard employment contract or a collective employment contract sets notice periods different from the statutory ones (seven days during probation, art. 335b para. 1; one month in the first year of service, two months in the second to ninth years, three months thereafter)?

documents.title: Notice of termination (letter, message or other record of the notice and its receipt)
documents.why: CO art. 336c para. 2: Voidness turns on the day the notice was given compared with the protected period, and the same day decides whether notice fell in probation; the notice and its date of receipt are the ordinary record of that day (the cited text sets no written form, so a message or other record serves).

documents.title: Employment contract or other record of the start of employment
must_show: Only if the file states that a written agreement or contract sets a probation period other than the first month of employment: the probation clause. Otherwise this item does not apply.
Only if the file states that a written contract sets notice periods different from the statutory ones: the notice-period clause. Otherwise this item does not apply.
documents.why: CO art. 335b para. 1: The probation period runs from the start of employment, and the year of service sets the 30, 90 or 180 days of art. 336c para. 1 let. b; the contract or another record of the start date ordinarily shows it.

documents.title: Written probation clause (individual agreement, standard or collective contract)
must_show: the written instrument that sets it
documents.why: CO art. 335b para. 2: A probation period other than the first month exists only under a written agreement or a standard or collective contract; that written clause proves its length and so whether notice came during it.

documents.title: Proof of the hindrance from working (medical certificate, or official order or summons for a non-voluntary legal obligation)
must_show: first and last day of incapacity
documents.why: CO art. 336c para. 1 let. b: The bar applies only while the employee is prevented from working by illness or accident, for at most 30, 90 or 180 days; a medical certificate is the ordinary proof of the incapacity and its dates, which with the start date of employment fix that period.

documents.title: Official confirmation of compulsory service
must_show: kind of service (military, civil defence, alternative civilian)
first and last day of service
documents.why: CO art. 336c para. 1 let. a: The bar depends on the kind of service, its dates and whether it lasted more than eleven days; the official service order or confirmation ordinarily shows all three.

documents.title: Medical confirmation of pregnancy or record of the birth
must_show: pregnancy confirmed and its dates, or the date of birth
documents.why: CO art. 336c para. 1 let. c: The bar runs during pregnancy and sixteen weeks after the birth; a medical confirmation of the pregnancy or the birth record ordinarily dates that period.

documents.title: Written notice-period clause (individual, standard or collective contract)
must_show: end-point of the notice (e.g. end of a month)
the written instrument that sets it (individual, standard or collective contract)
documents.why: CO art. 335c para. 2: A notice period other than the statutory one exists only under a written contract; resuming and extending a suspended notice period (art. 336c para. 3) needs its length and end-point, which that clause ordinarily shows.

steps.title: Establish whether the employer gave notice
Record the notice, the start of employment and the probation terms, and check that the probation period had expired when notice was given
Examine the illness or accident protected period
Examine the pregnancy and maternity protected period
Compute the suspended and extended notice period
Check whether the notice fell inside a protected period and is void
Assess the effect of the notice (void, suspended or valid)
Check branch: a protected period of let. a, b or c is raised
Check branch: notice before the protected period
Record the document state for assessment

outcomes.title: Process ends: The provision restrains only a termination by the employer
Process ends: The bar applies only after the probation period, extended under art. 335b para. 3 where it was interrupted, has expired

presumptions.text: Convention of this benchmark (not law): A fact that the file does not mention is taken as not alleged, and the rules are applied as if it were absent. Silence never ends a process: where a fact's absence would end it, the unmentioned fact is unresolved. The defining event is never presumed: if the file does not mention it, it is unresolved. A fact that the file raises and leaves unsettled is open.
